rulings: foot.col.plan «出行指南» APPROVED: a portal-style heading that covers all four links (行程规划 · 交通指南 · 我的行程 · 地图) and no longer repeats its first link 行程规划; 行前准备 rejected (pre-departure only, does not cover 我的行程/地图 used on the ground), 规划/出行规划 rejected (echo the link); sharing 指南 with the child link 交通指南 is a heading/child family, acceptable. cat.nature.t «自然风光» = categories.ts zh.nature verbatim (owner decision). historic 历史古迹 already identical in card and category - no change. foot.col.site 关于本站 already says «about this site» - no change.
blind_disposition: No objection from the blind reader: «自然风光» and «出行指南» read as natural. Nothing to apply or reject. Remaining points are source-level IA questions in ar too (events naming, taste/crafts cards, plan guide vs tool, Discover column, souqs+parks+farms) - logged for Eyad, unscored.
out_of_scope: Blind-reader IA points raised to Eyad, unscored (source-level, in ar too): events under two names (header/footer vs card vs H1); taste card now opens the cuisine page under another name; crafts card has no header/footer counterpart and opens all attractions; plan guide vs my-trip tool and column «Plan» over link «Plan your trip»; long mixed Discover column (ru reader proposes an «About Al-Ahsa» column); souqs+parks+farms header door vs three footer links (owner decision).
Dead keys foot.l.historic / foot.l.nature (all five languages; en still «Nature & farms») are not read by Footer.astro (Discover column uses catLabel) - remove or align in a code batch.
